notes: 2 program-list, 0 single-record, 23 not-a-list. Krannert Strategy alumni page (Purdue) is the useful one: a 16-row table of name / initial placement / current affiliation plus ten 2012-2016 dissertation titles; it is a strategic-management area, so area classification is needed. The Purdue e-Pubs open-access dissertations page is marked program-list only because it lists dissertations with authors; it is a university-wide repository browse page (2016 and 2015, all disciplines, no department field), so operations-relevant authors would have to be identified from titles and it is low priority. Two name lists were kept not-a-list by field: Purdue School of Engineering Education PhD alumni (2006-2015 with positions) and the Polytechnique Montréal geophysics theses list; integrator may reconsider if the field rule is relaxed. The RWTH Operations Research group theses page lists only bachelor's, master's and Diplom theses (its filter offers 'Diss' and 'Habil' but none appear in the capture); the group's navigation has an 'Alumni' page not in this batch. The saved text of that page is the gplus social-media variant of the same URL. Institutions by host were correct for every page.
